targets.label: Compiled (C backend, release)
targets.exampleRunCommand: ./compiler/bin/rae build --target compiled --project {{ENTRY_DIR}} --emit-c --out {{OUTDIR}}/out.c {{ENTRY}} && gcc {{OPT}} -o {{OUTDIR}}/app {{OUTDIR}}/out.c {{OUTDIR}}/rae_runtime.c third_party/raylib/rae_raylib.c third_party/tinyexpr/rae_tinyexpr.c $(ls {{ENTRY_DIR}}/*.c 2>/dev/null | grep -v "out.c" | grep -v "rae_runtime.c" || true) -I{{OUTDIR}} -Ithird_party/raylib -Ithird_party/tinyexpr -I/opt/homebrew/include -DRAE_HAS_RAYLIB -DRAE_HAS_SDL3 -DRAE_HAS_WEBGPU -I$HOME/.local/wgpu-native/include -L$HOME/.local/wgpu-native/lib -lwgpu_native -Wl,-rpath,$HOME/.local/wgpu-native/lib -framework Metal -framework QuartzCore -framework Foundation /opt/homebrew/lib/libraylib.a -L/opt/homebrew/lib -lSDL3 -framework CoreVideo -framework IOKit -framework Cocoa -framework OpenGL && {{OUTDIR}}/app

targets.label: Compiled (C backend, debug)

targets.label: Compiled (C backend, profiler)
targets.exampleRunCommand: ./compiler/bin/rae build --target compiled --project {{ENTRY_DIR}} --emit-c --out {{OUTDIR}}/out.c {{ENTRY}} && gcc -O2 -g -o {{OUTDIR}}/app {{OUTDIR}}/out.c {{OUTDIR}}/rae_runtime.c third_party/raylib/rae_raylib.c third_party/tinyexpr/rae_tinyexpr.c $(ls {{ENTRY_DIR}}/*.c 2>/dev/null | grep -v "out.c" | grep -v "rae_runtime.c" || true) -I{{OUTDIR}} -Ithird_party/raylib -Ithird_party/tinyexpr -I/opt/homebrew/include -DRAE_HAS_RAYLIB -DRAE_HAS_SDL3 -DRAE_HAS_WEBGPU -I$HOME/.local/wgpu-native/include -L$HOME/.local/wgpu-native/lib -lwgpu_native -Wl,-rpath,$HOME/.local/wgpu-native/lib -framework Metal -framework QuartzCore -framework Foundation /opt/homebrew/lib/libraylib.a -L/opt/homebrew/lib -lSDL3 -framework CoreVideo -framework IOKit -framework Cocoa -framework OpenGL && ( {{OUTDIR}}/app & APP=$!; sleep 1; echo '[profiler] sampling for up to 60s — scroll/interact now; report at /tmp/rae-profile.txt'; sample $APP 60 -file /tmp/rae-profile.txt -mayDie >/dev/null 2>&1; wait $APP ); echo '[profiler] hotspot report written to /tmp/rae-profile.txt'

targets.label: WASM (WebAssembly)
targets.description: Rae → C → wasm32-wasip1 (wasi-sdk), run headless via Node WASI. Headless examples only (raylib/windowed examples can't link to wasm). Needs wasi-sdk (WASI_SDK, default ~/.local/wasi-sdk).
